title: Why AI Data Centers Need So Much Water

scenes.narration: Artificial intelligence lives in the cloud.
But the cloud is actually a building.
Inside, thousands of powerful computers turn electricity into heat.
Every AI request sends specialized chips through enormous calculations.
Much of that energy eventually becomes heat.
Put thousands together and removing heat becomes an engineering problem.
Others circulate liquid close to computing equipment.
Cooling systems transfer heat through industrial infrastructure.
Some systems release part of that heat through water evaporation.
There is no universal number for how much water AI uses.
It depends on cooling, weather, electricity source and location.
Water also has a different meaning in a drought-prone region.
AI itself does not drink water. Physical infrastructure needs cooling.
The real question is how we should build that infrastructure as demand keeps growing.
